## Texts and drawings (12)

- **E2342** (text, sure): 日下舊聞考 三潭印月、天宇空明. 1780s (乾隆 敕撰) · j82:13b-14a · S05. https://github.com/kanripo/KR2k0036/blob/master/KR2k0036_082.txt
  > 方壺勝境西北為三潭印月又西北度橋為天宇空明其後為澄景堂堂東為清曠樓西為華照樓（圓明園册）臣等謹按三潭印月天宇空明諸額皆皇上御書
  North-west of 方壺勝境: 三潭印月; then over a bridge 天宇空明 with 澄景堂, 清曠樓 and 華照樓 behind.
- **E2344** (poem, sure): 澄景堂. 乾隆三十一年 (1766) · v3 p.194, under 天宇空明; source ref 9-212 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382569071850.pdf#page=197
  > 四时景有嬗，八牖纳无央。讵在烟花赏，惟饶翰墨香。入微得理趣，澄尽识真常。逐处寻题咏，缘因取义长。
  Poem 澄景堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1766, filed by the editors under 天宇空明.
- **E2346** (poem, sure): 清旷楼咏竹. 乾隆三十一年 (1766) · v3 p.194, under 天宇空明; source ref 9-212 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382569071850.pdf#page=197
  > 猗猗种竹满前庭，清矣其间旷意形。秋月入时留碎白，春风拂处动浮青。俯临常似披图画，得契宛堪悦性灵。
  Poem 清旷楼咏竹 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1766, filed by the editors under 天宇空明.
- **E2348** (poem, sure): 华照楼. 乾隆三十一年 (1766) · v3 p.195, under 天宇空明; source ref 9-212 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382569071850.pdf#page=198
  > 双桐院里两层楼，一片湖漪半座收。流丽云霞常映带，徘徊风月足勾留。无华了识不由素，有照偏欣都入幽。设问迩来即景句，披宜澄朗霁光浮。
  Poem 华照楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1766, filed by the editors under 天宇空明.
- **E2345** (poem, sure): 澄景堂. 乾隆三十二年 (1767) · v3 p.195, under 天宇空明; source ref 9-281 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382569071850.pdf#page=198
  > 试言澄景趣，只觉趣偏长。聒耳无丝竹，怡情有缥缃。新诗五七体，古帖两三行。更散庭前步，天空水一方。
  Poem 澄景堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1767, filed by the editors under 天宇空明.
- **E2347** (poem, sure): 清旷楼. 乾隆三十二年 (1767) · v3 p.195, under 天宇空明; source ref 9-267 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382569071850.pdf#page=198
  > 拾级高楼旷且清，非夸画栋与雕甍。石墙以外见墟里，为忆民艰及物情。
  Poem 清旷楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1767, filed by the editors under 天宇空明.
- **E2349** (poem, sure): 华照楼. 乾隆五十五年 (1790) · v3 p.199, under 天宇空明; source ref 17-177 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382569071850.pdf#page=202
  > 华诚属于物，照本在乎楼。二非一何立，主标宾自投。讵惟供目给，实不出心谋。寄语正心者，诸凡理可求。
  Poem 华照楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1790, filed by the editors under 天宇空明.
- **E2000** (description, sure): Site status table, about 2011: scattered remains only. c. 2011 · 系列06 repost, status table · S356. https://blog.sina.com.cn/s/blog_c27029650101itzz.html
  Scenes with only scattered, incomplete building remains in the same table. 方壶胜境 is listed separately as the one with fairly complete remains not yet tidied up. 紫碧山房, 舍卫城 and 如园 have been dug since.
- **E1852** (description, sure): 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v2, editors' note on 方壶胜境. 2020 edition · v2 p.328 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382343267004.pdf#page=331
  A temple garden from early Qianlong: on a high terrace in the water the double-eaved 迎薰亭 with 集瑞亭 and 凝祥亭, then three five-bay towers 宜春殿, 哕鸾殿, 琼华楼, each with paired side towers. The note counts 2,235 Buddha images in the nine towers. East court 蕊珠宫; 三潭印月 to the west.
- **E2343** (drawing, sure): 《国家图书馆藏样式雷图档·圆明园卷初编》: 三潭印月. mostly 道光, 咸丰, 同治 per the publisher · 初编 目录: 三潭印月, pp.435-436 · S13. https://www.nlcpress.com/ProductView.aspx?Id=7642
  The printed facsimile of the National Library of China's Yangshi Lei sheets has a section on this place at pp.435-436 (2 pages, section length worked out from the next heading); sheet titles and numbers are in the volume, ordered from a library.
- **E1857** (plan, sure): 《圆明园四十景》图的价值: 方壶胜境 leaf. 2020 · jzys · S337. http://iqh.ruc.edu.cn/old/qdhjylyjzx/xszl/jzys/8eef05885c3e4279ae0132f1a37a13c9.htm
  Says the 方壶胜境 leaf also shows its neighbours: 蕊珠宫 east, the three small stone pagodas and pavilions of 三潭印月 west, 天宇空明 north, two timber bridges south. So one leaf can witness several objects.
- **E1877** (plan, sure): 三幅样式雷圆明园河道全图辨析: earth moved. 2024 · NLC 043, changes between plans, item 9 · S337. http://iqh.ruc.edu.cn/old/qdhjylyjzx/xszl/jzys/59b83e20f7ab4840b746a6208a550939.htm
  One listed change between plans: the hill at 澡身浴德 was removed and earth was added beside 藏舟坞, south-east of 方壶胜境, and east of 三潭印月, spoil from dredging being the usual source. Useful for the hills layer on the east shore.
